source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public 25:1–18, 26:2–65, 27–28 and 29:1–39 align directly. Public 26:1 combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1, each bound separately in source_segments. Public 29:40 maps to Hebrew 30:1; public 30:1–16 maps to Hebrew 30:2–17. All 194 original records are hashed exactly for 193 public verses.

key_decisions.decision: Combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1 at the established public label while binding both complete original XML records separately.
Supplies the census action implicit in the abbreviated age clause and attaches the Israelites to the command’s recipients; alternative clause division is noted.
Preserves the three names, representative status and two levels of opposition; written/read forms remain exactly bound.
Preserves swallowing of Korah, the earth-mouth image, 250 deaths and the warning without harmonizing away the recap’s wording.
Keeps the explicit survival exception, which limits claims made about Korah’s whole family elsewhere.
Keeps all five daughters named in source order and the no-sons qualification that prepares chapter 27.
Preserves the named daughter among the clan records rather than omitting a non-census entry.
Preserves lot allocation alongside proportional allotment without inventing a mechanism to reconcile them.
Keeps the lot’s decisive role and larger/smaller contrast, closing the land-allocation speech.
Preserves the stated Levi relationship and Egyptian birth without silently expanding generations; names Miriam alongside both brothers.
Keeps the two deaths and unauthorized fire connection without inventing their motive or the precise defect in the fire.
Retains the generational contrast specifically within census membership, not every living person.
Keeps the emphatic death statement and both named exceptions with their fathers.
